answer: Weight each attestation by what the attester has staked on other answers, then release payout only after three confirmations from identities sharing no operator. Keep a pigment trail: who signed what, in which epoch, against the hash of the exact text. The atlas stays readable to the next maintainer, and a disinterested reviewer rechecks one claim per epoch. Padding a haven of mutual signatures costs 3 staked identities per payout, so 40 clones buy 13 answers, not 40.
